terminal.eligibility: During exploration, declare terminal only with eligible complete source in exact request-local table. Forced finalization declares terminal even if table empty; an empty selection is honest but invalid localization. No correction, extraction, or summary-field normalization.

capacity: Measure full fresh request first. If context admission fails, expose explicit compact method/catalog deferral notices with originals retained; no first-delivery credit for withheld source. Small metadata pages/other complete methods remain eligible. Never truncate a method or treat missing source as irrelevant.
action_budget: Expose exact remaining repository attempts, charge invalid/recovery attempts, enter terminal-only phase after ten. Excess proposed batches still fail before the eleventh execution; terminal declaration itself is not a repository acquisition.
audit: Post-full32-seal request/usage/source audit supports both prospective terminal forms and checks canonical index-declared method extents, not only self-reported complete_method. Confirmed-source counter is explicitly restricted to valid episodes. Compact terminal selection reconstructs the exact request-matched private table and original source IDs, without model-output normalization. Reconstruct exact boolean finalization phase; reject missing or phase-flipped presentation and any extra summary field. Additionally reconstruct every recorded state presentation, including invalid episodes, from prior receipt prefix and saved exact index tokenizer requests. Detect omitted navigation records and any control navigation memory; validate original512-token/4096-byte budget and <=4 fitting measurements. Reuse separately qualified canonical serialized-JSON navigation comparator prospectively; no original r6 evaluator edits. Every normal full tokenizer/generation request must have exact task/common contract and treatment-only policy suffix. Every generation binds prior identical-message/tools measured request with original8K cap, including invalid episodes. Scorer additionally requires successful matching full32 audit before labels.
